遠端伺服器的域名或 IP。域名會走 DNS，解析失敗回錯誤碼 565。手冊範例用: The remote server's domain name or IP. A domain name goes through DNS and returns error code 565 if resolution fails. The manual's example address 192.0.2.2 is a documentation-reserved address, not a real server. The default, tcpbin.com:4243, is a TLS echo service (verified working in the P5 run on 2026-08-07). ⚠ It idles out after only 15 seconds, so send your data promptly once connected, and it echoes line by line — a payload without a trailing newline never comes back.
遠端伺服器的域名或 IP。與 buffer 模式的差別只在最後一個參數 <acc: The remote server's domain name or IP. The only difference from buffer mode is the last parameter <access_mode>=1: received data is emitted directly as URCs by the module and you never issue AT+QSSLRECV. The default tcpbin.com:4243 likewise idles out after 15 seconds and echoes line by line.
伺服器的監聽埠。tcpbin 的 TLS echo 是 4243、HTTPS 為: The port the server listens on. tcpbin's TLS echo is 4243, HTTPS is 443, MQTT over TLS is 8883. The manual's examples use 8010 / 8011.
